AUTOMOWER.NAME: Husqvarna Automower
AUTOMOWER.DESCRIPTION: Husqvarna Automower robot mowers via the official Automower Connect API

APPLICATION_KEY.NAME: Application key
APPLICATION_KEY.DESCRIPTION: Application key from developer.husqvarnagroup.cloud (connected to the Authentication API and the Automower Connect API)

POLL.NAME: Full read interval [s]
POLL.DESCRIPTION: Changes arrive live through the web socket. The API allows 21000 requests per week per application

SCAN.NAME: Search mowers
SCAN.DESCRIPTION: Lists the mowers of the account

SOCKET_CONNECTED.NAME: Live connection
SOCKET_CONNECTED.DESCRIPTION: True while the web socket is connected

DEFAULT_MINUTES.NAME: Default mowing duration [min]
DEFAULT_MINUTES.DESCRIPTION: Used when Mowing is set to true

CONNECTED.NAME: Connected
CONNECTED.DESCRIPTION: The mower is reachable by the cloud

ACTIVITY.NAME: Activity
ACTIVITY.DESCRIPTION: MOWING, GOING_HOME, CHARGING, LEAVING, PARKED_IN_CS, STOPPED_IN_GARDEN, ...

STATE.NAME: State
STATE.DESCRIPTION: IN_OPERATION, PAUSED, RESTRICTED, OFF, STOPPED, ERROR, ...

RESTRICTED_REASON.NAME: Restriction
RESTRICTED_REASON.DESCRIPTION: NONE, WEEK_SCHEDULE, PARK_OVERRIDE, SENSOR, DAILY_LIMIT, FROST, ...

MOWING.NAME: Mowing
MOWING.DESCRIPTION: Write true to mow for the default duration, false to park until the next schedule

MOW_MINUTES.NAME: Mow for [min]
MOW_MINUTES.DESCRIPTION: Write minutes to mow that long, 0 to park until the next schedule

PARK_MINUTES.NAME: Park for [min]
PARK_MINUTES.DESCRIPTION: Write minutes to park that long

PAUSE.NAME: Pause
PAUSE.DESCRIPTION: Write true to stop the mower where it is

RESUME_SCHEDULE.NAME: Resume schedule
RESUME_SCHEDULE.DESCRIPTION: Write true to return to the schedule
